t: This is 32 Bruton Street, a building in Mayfair. It matters for one birth: Edwina Mountbatten was born here in 1901. She became an English heiress and socialite, and later a relief worker. As the wife of Louis Mountbatten, she served as the last vicereine of India. For her work with the St John Ambulance Brigade and the British Red Cross during the Second World War, she was made a Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 1943, and a Dame Commander of the Royal Victorian Order in 1946.
